title: Divide et Impera
wikitext:
A [[4on4]] clan consisting of [[HPW |HPW's ]] that populated the servers back in [[1999]] or so when Quakeworld was still at its prime.

== History ==
Divide et Impera was founded by [[Alpha 1]] (aka [[Åke Vader]]) and his cousin [[Z-Q-03]] (aka [[Björta]]) after having spent several hours on the FZ gibfest servers and wanted to try out the action in 4on4. DEI always had a hard time winning games and some of their opponents were [[Quake Undertakers]], [[NoNS]] and [[SPLATT]] which never offered easy resistance. The first four players were [[Alpha 1]], [[Z-Q-03]], [[Quid]] and [[Vulcanizer]]. After a while [[Necropulse]] (now [[Pulsen]]) was added to the roster which was seen as a good recruitment.

== Information ==

* Founded: [[1999]] by [[Alpha 1]] and [[Z-Q-03]]
* Nationality: [[Image:flag_se.gif]] Swedish
* Clan prefix: dei
* IRC channel: [irc://port80.se.quakenet.org/dei #dei] ([[QuakeNet]]) (IRC channel now taken over by danes)
* Website: [http://web.archive.org/web/20021106075445/www.angelfire.com/ct/DEI/ www.angelfire.com/ct/DEI] (homepage vanished, parts left on web.archive.org in this link)
